brief:
Israeli occupation authorities renewed a six-month ban preventing Sheikh Muhammad Hussein, the Grand Mufti of Jerusalem and the Palestinian territories and imam of Al-Aqsa Mosque, from entering the mosque compound, according to Jerusalem sources cited by Shehab Wire. The restriction marks a continuation of measures limiting the senior Palestinian religious figure's access to the site.

Hussein serves as the chief Islamic cleric for Jerusalem and leads prayers at Al-Aqsa, one of Islam's holiest sites. Israeli authorities have previously imposed similar bans on Palestinian religious and political leaders at the mosque, which sits within the Old City's compound known to Muslims as Haram al-Sharif and to Israelis as the Temple Mount.
